name: Noetix Robotics
summary: Noetix Robotics (Songyan Dynamics) is a Beijing startup founded in September 2023 by a team from Tsinghua and Zhejiang universities. It sells low-cost small humanoids such as N2 and the consumer Bumi.

sources.title: China's Noetix Robotics launches $1,400 consumer-grade humanoid robot
Startup NOETIX Robotics Launches Affordable Humanoid Robot Capable of Backflips
